$comment: Exact versions of the third-party code that ships inside the APK but is not resolved by Gradle. Hand-maintained; update whenever a bundled package is replaced. Licenses and upstream links live in THIRD_PARTY.md.

chaquopy.relocationPolicy: Packages stay at the top level of app/src/main/python/. Moving them under app/src/main/python/vendor/ would change sys.path import resolution for gallery_dl and its dependencies; a relocation would need a matching vendor/ entry on the Chaquopy source set and a re-test of every Python entry point, so it is deliberately not done.

nativeBinaries.name: yt-dlp
nativeBinaries.location: AAR payload (res/raw/ytdlp), initialized into the app's private filesDir at first run
nativeBinaries.evidence: __version__ in the ytdlp payload of the youtubedl-android 0.17.3 AAR

nativeBinaries.name: FFmpeg
nativeBinaries.location: libffmpeg.so / libffprobe.so per ABI (jni payload extracted from the AAR)
nativeBinaries.evidence: libavformat version string in the AAR's libffmpeg.zip.so payload; the shipping CLI carries no version banner
